review_basis: Per-case action, outcome, phase and ending facts in motion_protocol.json with descriptions v2. Contrasts keep the designated entities and change direction, mechanism, destination, ordering or final configuration. Expected answers are no for these factual alternatives; ISR participant identity remains yes. A08 uses funnel levels, with no collection-tray claim. D02, D03 and D06 have no motion questions.

cross.action: The cars in the straight-through lanes make U-turns inside the junction and head back toward their incoming road arms.
cross.outcome: The same straight-through cars return to the road arms from which they entered.

turn.action: The car approaching from the bottom in the inner lane makes a right turn toward image-right.
turn.outcome: The bottom-entry inner-lane car leaves the junction along the road toward image-right.

LRA.turn: The car initially approaching from the bottom in the inner lane turns right and settles onto the outgoing road toward image-right.

EndState: The moving cars have gathered into a compact cluster in the center of the intersection.
The road arms have rotated around the intersection relative to the surrounding ground.

break.action: The cue ball pushes the numbered balls across the table as one compact group, preserving their neighbor arrangement throughout contact.
break.outcome: The numbered balls have shifted together into a compact rack at a new table location.

spread.action: The numbered balls roll toward one another and assemble into a compact triangular rack after the cue-ball contact.
spread.outcome: The numbered balls finish packed together in a single triangular group.

LRA.rack_motion: Object ball 1 near the lower front edge of the opening group rises vertically off the table during the cue-ball break.

EndState: The numbered balls form a compact triangular rack at the ending.
The visible balls are suspended above the table surface.

convey.action: The upright bottles travel backward along the conveyor, moving from the machine output toward the incoming queue.
convey.outcome: The followed bottles have returned upstream toward the incoming end of the belt.

LRA.gate_release: The retractable metering stop rises upward into the bottle path during its release stroke.

EndState: The bottles are lying on their sides across the conveyor.
The followed bottles have moved upstream relative to their opening locations.

sail.action: The sailboats roll sideways until their masts dip toward the water as their hulls capsize.
sail.outcome: The followed boats finish on their sides with their masts at the water surface.

LRA.sail: The sailboats tip sideways and roll their masts toward the lake surface.
LRA.pass: The passing boats collide and overturn onto their sides.

EndState: Several boats lie capsized with their masts in the water.
The boats have gathered hull-to-hull into a single tightly packed cluster.

rotate.action: The carousel horses slide radially inward along the platform toward the central axis.
rotate.outcome: The horses are clustered around the hub at smaller distances from the axis.

bob.action: Individual horses roll upside down around horizontal axes as the carousel carries them around.
bob.outcome: The horses finish inverted beside their poles with their feet pointing upward.

LRA.rotate: The carousel horses travel radially inward from the outer ring toward the hub.
LRA.bob: The horses roll upside down around horizontal axes beside their poles.

EndState: The horses have gathered into a cluster at the central hub.
The carousel platform and its central support have separated into loose pieces.

oscillate.action: The pendulum balls travel steadily upward along their suspension lines toward the support rail.
oscillate.outcome: The suspension lines have shortened and the balls have gathered against the upper rail.

LRA.swing: The balls move upward along their suspension lines toward the support rail.
LRA.phases: The suspension points slide together along the upper rail and bring the hanging balls into one cluster.

EndState: The balls rest on the floor beneath the support frame.
The support frame has slid sideways across the floor relative to its opening position.

circulate.action: The Ferris-wheel gondolas move inward along the spokes toward the fixed hub.
circulate.outcome: The gondolas have collected beside the hub at the center of the wheel.

LRA.rotate: The gondolas slide inward from the wheel rim toward its hub.
LRA.continue: The passenger baskets turn upside down as they pass around the wheel.

EndState: The gondolas are gathered at the center of the wheel beside the hub.
The passenger baskets hang upside down with their openings facing the ground.

descend.action: The marbles climb out of the lower funnels and travel upward into higher funnel levels.
descend.outcome: The followed marbles reach funnel levels above their own opening levels.

LRA.descend: The followed marbles climb from their opening funnels through the outlets into higher levels of the apparatus.

EndState: The followed marbles occupy higher funnel levels than at the beginning.

initiation.action: The terminal domino at the far end tips first and starts a falling sequence toward the opening trigger end.
initiation.outcome: Toppling begins at the terminal end and progresses back toward the first domino.

cascade.action: Fallen dominoes rise upright one after another as a recovery wave travels along the row.
cascade.outcome: The row has returned to an upright arrangement after the recovery wave.

LRA.first_domino: The initiating domino rises from a flat pose into an upright position.
LRA.last_domino: The terminal domino rises from the surface into an upright position as the sequence reaches it.

EndState: The whole domino row stands upright at the ending.
The fallen dominoes have risen back onto their narrow bases.

first_exchange.action: After the released rightmost ball strikes, all the cradle balls swing outward together as a rigid row.
first_exchange.outcome: The central balls and both end balls are displaced outward together as one group.

return_exchange.action: The returning leftmost ball lifts the entire central row upward during its collision.
return_exchange.outcome: The central balls finish raised above both outer balls.

catch.action: The returning hand catches and holds the leftmost ball at its raised position.
catch.outcome: The hand finishes holding the raised leftmost ball.

LRA.hand_withdrawal: The hand moves inward toward the rightmost ball and pushes it toward the center of the cradle.

EndState: The hand holds the leftmost ball in a raised position.
The middle balls are held high above the two end balls.

impact.action: The bowling ball strikes the rear of the pin formation after traveling from the back of the lane toward the front pin.
impact.outcome: The rear pins start falling before the ball reaches the front headpin.

scatter.action: The pins slide together into a compact upright group after the ball contact.
scatter.outcome: Every pin finishes standing upright in a tightly packed formation.

LRA.headpin_fall: The front headpin rises from a fallen pose and returns to standing as the bowling ball arrives.

EndState: Most pins stand upright at the end of the lane.
Every pin is lying flat at the ending.

top_transfer.action: The marble travels backward from the upper return track into the top of the elevator and starts descending with the lift.
top_transfer.outcome: The followed marble ends back inside the descending lift after leaving the upper track.

bottom_return.action: The lift ejects the arriving marble backward onto the lower return track.
bottom_return.outcome: The followed marble rolls away from the lift inlet along the lower track.

LRA.top_transfer: The target marble moves from the upper descending track backward into the elevator at its top exit.

EndState: The marbles have gathered into a stationary pile below the return track.
The lift carries its marbles downward toward the lower inlet.

scoop_lift.action: The excavator lowers a soil-filled bucket and pours its contents back into the digging patch before raising it empty.
scoop_lift.outcome: The raised bucket is empty and the carried soil has been deposited at the digging patch.

load_truck.action: The bucket takes soil out of the truck bed and carries it toward the digging side.
load_truck.outcome: Soil has been removed from the truck bed and retained in the excavator bucket.

LRA.slew_to_truck: The loaded excavator upper body swivels away from the truck toward the digging patch during its first loaded swivel.

EndState: The bucket remains tipped downward in its truck-unloading pose.
The excavator is turning from the digging side toward the truck.

road_before.action: The opening road car drives off the bridge deck into the canal before the bridge opens.
road_before.outcome: The followed opening car ends in the canal below the bridge.

boat_pass.action: The boat climbs onto the raised bridge leaves and crosses along their road surfaces.
boat_pass.outcome: The boat finishes supported on top of the bridge roadway.

road_restore.action: Cars drive across the gap while both bridge leaves remain raised.
road_restore.outcome: The road cars cross above the canal with the bridge leaves still standing upright.

LRA.bridge_open: The target bridge leaf rotates downward below the horizontal roadway during its first opening stroke.
LRA.bridge_close: The raised target bridge leaf rotates farther upward during the closing stroke.

EndState: Both bridge leaves remain raised above a gap in the road.
The road cars are gathered in the canal under the bridge.

raise.action: The loaded forklift lowers its pallet from the opening fork height onto the warehouse floor.
raise.outcome: The pallet rests on the floor below the height of the truck bed.

unload.action: The forklift lifts the pallet back out of the truck and reverses while still carrying the cartons on its forks.
unload.outcome: The pallet and cartons leave the truck supported by the reversing forklift.

LRA.forks_raise: The loaded forks move downward relative to the forklift mast during the first fork stroke.

EndState: The pallet of cartons is supported on the forks outside the truck.
The reversing forklift carries the deposited load away from the truck.

slow.action: The leading carton accelerates as it enters the output rollers, moving progressively faster relative to the frame.
slow.outcome: The leading carton reaches a higher forward speed on the output rollers.

accumulate.action: The cartons accelerate away from one another as they enter the output rollers and open wider gaps.
accumulate.outcome: The cartons finish widely separated and still advancing rapidly along the rollers.

LRA.final_carton_stop: The same leading carton nearest the downstream end accelerates forward from its settled position and opens a gap behind it.

EndState: The cartons are widely spaced along the output rollers.
The ending queue is traveling rapidly backward toward the incoming conveyor.

enter.action: The coaches enter the tunnel tail first while the locomotive reverses behind them.
enter.outcome: The rear coach disappears before the locomotive as the train enters backward.

exit.action: The train reverses and emerges back through the same left-hand portal used for entry.
exit.outcome: The connected train is visible outside the left-hand entry portal after reversing.

LRA.occlusion: The target train climbs onto the tunnel roof and travels over the tunnel exterior.

EndState: The train is outside the left-hand entry portal after returning backward.
The coaches are detached and scattered beside the track.

underpass.action: The followed boats rise from the water and travel over the bridge roadway.
underpass.outcome: The followed boats finish supported on top of the bridge deck.

LRA.occlusion: The designated boat climbs onto the top of the bridge deck and passes over the roadway.

EndState: The boats rest on their sides on top of the bridge deck.
The bridge has shifted sideways across the water relative to its opening supports.

enter.action: The approaching person climbs onto the roof of the revolving-door enclosure.
enter.outcome: The person is standing on top of the door enclosure during passage.

exit.action: The person reverses through the revolving door and returns to the left-hand approach side.
exit.outcome: The person emerges on the left and walks back toward the opening approach location.

LRA.occlusion: The followed person climbs above the revolving-door panels onto the enclosure roof.

EndState: The person is visible outside on the left approach side of the door.
The revolving-door enclosure lies toppled on its side.

reappear.action: The cable-car cabins detach from the cable and descend vertically toward the ground during passage.
reappear.outcome: The followed cabins reach the ground below the elevated cable route.

LRA.occlusion: The designated cable-car cabin drops vertically away from the elevated cable toward the ground.

EndState: The two cabins rest on the ground beneath the cable route.
The two cabins have met at the same point on the cable and formed one cluster.

aisle.action: The forklift raises itself onto the upper shelving and drives along the top of the racks.
aisle.outcome: The forklift finishes supported on the upper shelf above the stored cartons.

LRA.occlusion: The followed forklift climbs upward onto the shelving instead of passing through the aisle.

EndState: The forklift is supported on the top shelf above the cartons.
The shelving and stored cartons have toppled into the aisle.

roads.action: The followed cars jump from one road level to another while crossing the interchange.
roads.outcome: The followed cars finish on different roadway levels from their own opening routes.

LRA.occlusion: The designated car leaves its opening road ring and jumps onto a different elevated road level.

EndState: The followed cars rest on the ground below the elevated roads.
The elevated road decks have collapsed onto the ground.

wash.action: The car climbs onto the roof of the wash housing and drives over the enclosure.
wash.outcome: The same car finishes on the roof of the wash housing.

LRA.occlusion: The target car drives up onto the roof of the car-wash housing.

EndState: The car rests on top of the wash housing.
The wash housing has toppled sideways across the lane.

cover.action: The cup initially above the ball rises farther away from the tabletop during the covering stroke.
cover.outcome: The ball remains exposed below the raised covering cup throughout that stroke.

shuffle_reveal.action: After the shuffle, the tracked covering cup lowers and presses its rim against the tabletop.
shuffle_reveal.outcome: The ball stays hidden underneath the lowered tracked cup at the ending.

LRA.cup_cover: The cup initially positioned over the ball moves upward away from the tabletop during the first covering stroke.
LRA.cup_reveal: The same covering cup moves downward toward the tabletop during its post-shuffle reveal stroke.

EndState: The ball is hidden underneath the tracked covering cup at the ending.
The cups have been placed in a vertical stack on top of one another.

drive.action: The followed car leaves the curved road and drives across the roadside ground.
drive.outcome: The car finishes off the pavement in the roadside scenery.

LRA.drive: The car drives off the curved road onto the roadside ground.
LRA.continue: The car rolls onto its roof beside the road bend.

EndState: The car lies upside down beside the pavement.
The road and roadside scenery rotate together around the car in the world.

spin.action: The turbine blades fold inward along their lengths toward the rotor hubs.
spin.outcome: The blades finish folded into compact bundles against the hubs.

LRA.rotate: The turbine blades fold inward toward their hubs rather than sweeping around them.
LRA.continue: The entire turbine towers tip sideways toward the ground.

EndState: The turbine rotors rest on the ground beside the towers.
The tower bases have slid away from their opening ground locations.

departure.action: The followed yacht approaches its starting berth from the harbor and docks alongside it.
departure.outcome: The followed yacht finishes back at its berth beside the dock.

LRA.depart: The followed yacht moves inward toward its starting berth and docks.
LRA.navigate: The previously berthed yachts leave the docks together and follow the moving yacht.

EndState: The followed yacht is docked at its starting berth.
The other yachts have left their berths and gathered in the open harbor.

travel.action: The train leaves the viaduct rails and descends sideways off the elevated track.
travel.outcome: The locomotive and coaches finish below the viaduct beside its piers.

LRA.travel: The locomotive drives sideways off the elevated track toward the ground below.
LRA.continue: The coaches detach from the locomotive and scatter off the viaduct.

EndState: The train rests below the railway viaduct.
The coaches are detached from one another and scattered beside the locomotive.

rides.action: The Ferris-wheel gondolas slide inward to the hub, the coaster leaves its rails, and the tower carriage moves sideways away from its guide.
rides.outcome: The ride vehicles finish detached from their wheel rim, track and tower guide.

LRA.wheel: The Ferris-wheel gondolas slide inward along the spokes toward the hub.
LRA.coaster: The roller-coaster train leaves the elevated rails and falls toward the ground.
LRA.tower: The drop-tower carriage moves sideways off the tower guide.

EndState: The amusement ride support structures have collapsed into separate pieces.
The ride vehicles rest detached on the ground beneath their routes.

pickup.action: The gripper presses the cassette downward through its pickup fixture instead of raising it from the support.
pickup.outcome: The cassette ends below the pickup table after being pushed downward.

carry.action: The robot releases the cassette during its transfer and lets it fall from the gripper.
carry.outcome: The cassette rests below the arm after dropping away from the gripper.

LRA.payload_first_lift: The target cassette moves downward from its opening supported height as the gripper first engages it.

EndState: The cassette rests on the pickup table under an empty gripper.
The robot arm links are detached and scattered around the base.

cycle.action: The lift platform tips onto its side while the crossed support links fold sideways.
cycle.outcome: The platform finishes vertical beside the base with its top surface facing sideways.

repeat.action: During the second cycle, the platform rotates upside down over the scissor links.
repeat.outcome: The platform finishes inverted above the base.

LRA.first_top: The platform tilts from level to vertical while completing its first upward stroke.
LRA.second_rise: The platform moves downward during the second upward-stroke interval after the first cycle.

EndState: The platform remains at its highest extension above the base.
The crossed arms have detached from their pivots and lie separately on the base.

unfold.action: The umbrella ribs fold inward and pull the fabric tight against the central shaft during the opening stroke.
unfold.outcome: The canopy finishes folded into a narrow bundle around the shaft.

LRA.umbrella_open: The ribs fold inward toward the shaft and close the canopy during the first unfolding stroke.

EndState: The umbrella canopy is folded tightly around the central shaft.
The canopy lies separately from its ribs and shaft.

flutter.action: The curtain panels rise upward and wind into tight rolls along their upper support.
flutter.outcome: The curtains finish rolled into compact cylinders above the window.

LRA.billow: The curtain panels wind upward into tight rolls at their upper support.
LRA.continue: The curtain panels detach from their upper support and fall onto the floor.

EndState: The curtains lie on the floor beneath the window.
The curtain fabric has split into separate narrow strips.

waves.action: The athlete winds both ropes into tight coils around the hands, drawing the far ends inward.
waves.outcome: The ropes finish gathered into compact coils beside the athlete's hands.

LRA.waves: The athlete winds the ropes into tight coils around the hands.
LRA.continue: The ropes pull taut into straight rigid lengths while their far ends move toward the athlete.

EndState: Both ropes are broken into disconnected segments.
The athlete has released both near ends onto the ground.

squeeze.action: The sponge moves downward as a rigid block while preserving its opening height and width throughout the squeeze.
squeeze.outcome: The sponge has translated downward with the same rigid rectangular shape throughout.

water.action: Droplets rise upward from the basin and enter the sponge during compression.
water.outcome: The released droplets travel upward from below the sponge into its surface.

LRA.first_compression: The sponge increases its top-to-bottom height throughout the first compression interval.
LRA.first_recovery: The sponge decreases its top-to-bottom height during the recovery immediately after its first compressed minimum.

EndState: The sponge remains flattened at its minimum compressed thickness.
The basin is positioned above the sponge.

linkage.action: The walking mechanism changes leg posture by stretching and shortening the rigid links between fixed joints.
linkage.outcome: The leg links have changed their lengths substantially while their joint angles stay fixed.

LRA.articulate: The leg links stretch longer between their pinned joints as the walking mechanism cycles.
LRA.continue: The walking links pull apart at their joints and fall away from the main frame.

EndState: The walking links lie disconnected from their joints.
The originally rigid links are bent into curved shapes.

feed.action: The textile tears across its width as the rollers pull the web into separate pieces.
feed.outcome: The fabric emerges as disconnected short strips below the rollers.

LRA.feed: The textile tears across its width into separate pieces between the rollers.
LRA.continue: The hanging textile loop winds into a tight roll and rises completely above the supports.

EndState: The textile is split into disconnected pieces between the rollers.
The machine supports lie toppled over the fabric.

packing.action: The robots lift chocolate bars out of the packing cartons and place them onto the incoming conveyor lanes.
packing.outcome: The transferred chocolate has moved from the packing cartons back onto the conveyor.

LRA.chocolate_lift: The leading chocolate bar in the near conveyor lane moves downward below its belt-supported height during the first pickup stroke.

EndState: The chocolate bars are gathered into one mixed pile between the two lanes.
The robot arms and packing cartons have fallen across the incoming conveyor lanes.

transfer.action: The mechanism picks a ball out of the receiving tray and carries it back to the opening pickup support.
transfer.outcome: The transferred ball has returned from the receiving tray to the pickup support.

LRA.ball_lift: The first ball in the opening left-to-right order descends from the pickup support during its first upward transfer interval.

EndState: The LEGO figure lies separated into pieces at its joints.
The balls are suspended in open space away from the transfer mechanism.

trigger.action: The first tall distributor domino rises upright from the tabletop and pushes the trigger marble back up its launch ramp.
trigger.outcome: The trigger marble has returned up the ramp as the distributor stands upright.

cascade.action: The small field dominoes rise upright in sequence as a recovery wave travels back toward the distributor chain.
cascade.outcome: The field dominoes finish standing upright after the recovery wave.

LRA.first_trigger: The first tall distributor domino rises toward its upright pose as the marble reaches it.
LRA.last_fall: The terminal small domino at the far-right end of the farthest row rises upright as the sequence reaches it.

EndState: Most field dominoes stand upright at the ending.
The previously toppled dominoes have risen onto their narrow bases.

hoist.action: The spreader pushes the handling container downward into its starting vehicle during the hoisting stroke.
hoist.outcome: The selected container is below its opening support level within the starting vehicle.

place.action: The crane returns the hoisted container to the vehicle from which it was picked up.
place.outcome: The container is supported on its original vehicle after the transfer.

LRA.container_hoist: The handling container moves downward from its starting vehicle during its first hoisting stroke.
LRA.container_lower: The same container gains height away from the receiving vehicle during the first placement stroke.

EndState: The handled container rests on the original pickup vehicle.
The spreader rests directly on the placed container and remains engaged with its top.

hold.action: The queued road cars drive onto the tracks while the barrier arms lower and the train passes.
hold.outcome: The waiting cars occupy the rail crossing alongside the passing train.

release.action: After the train clears, the queued cars reverse away from the crossing as the barrier arms rise.
release.outcome: The queued vehicles retreat from the tracks toward their approach roads after reopening.

LRA.barrier_close: The near-side barrier arm rotates upward during its first closing stroke.
LRA.barrier_open: The same barrier arm rotates downward across the road during its first reopening stroke.

EndState: The train is still occupying the road crossing.
The queued road cars are reversing away from the reopened crossing.

pickup.action: The robot carries the selected first arriving carton from the pallet back onto the incoming conveyor.
pickup.outcome: The same selected first arriving carton rests back on the incoming conveyor after transfer from the pallet.

stack.action: The robot carries the selected arriving carton back from the pallet and lowers it onto its original conveyor pickup position.
stack.outcome: The selected carton rests back on the incoming conveyor after the gripper withdraws.

LRA.carton_lift: The leading arriving carton moves downward below its conveyor-supported height during the first pickup stroke.
LRA.carton_place: The same selected carton rises away from the pallet during its first placement stroke.

EndState: The transferred carton rests back on the conveyor at the pickup end.
The robot links and conveyor supports lie detached around the work cell.

coasters.action: The coaster trains leave their rails and descend off the sides of the elevated track.
coasters.outcome: The coaster trains finish on the ground below the rails.

wheel.action: The Ferris-wheel gondolas slide radially inward from the rim toward the hub.
wheel.outcome: The gondolas gather into a cluster at the center of the wheel.

LRA.coasters: The connected coaster trains leave the rails and fall off the elevated track.
LRA.wheel: The Ferris-wheel gondolas slide inward along the spokes toward the hub.

EndState: The coaster cars lie detached on the ground beneath the track.
The Ferris-wheel gondolas are gathered at the hub instead of around the rim.

handling.action: The LEGO robot lifts the leading packet out of a receiving pocket and returns it to the conveyor pickup end.
handling.outcome: The same packet rests back on the conveyor after transfer from the receiving pocket.

LRA.packet_lift: The leading packet moves downward below its conveyor-supported height during its first pickup stroke.
LRA.packet_place: The same selected packet gains height away from the receiving pocket during its first placement stroke.

EndState: The robot links lie detached at their joints.
The transferred packets rest on the floor below the receiving pockets.
